resume: Felucca played from an Arturia MiniLab 3: track faders, master DJ filter, momentary effect pads, 32 sounds per bank and 12 evolving songs. The FM-1 panel remains Felucca's: four tracks, 64-step sequencer, thirteen engines.

commandes.role: Octave down. In actions and dialogs, goes back.
Octave up. In actions and dialogs, confirms.
Effects page; held: FX layer (repeat, reverse, sweeps, tape stop, freeze, harmonizer).
Printed SCL in the docs. Scale page, then chord page; held: SCL layer.
Sound editing pages; held: EDIT layer.
Back to the home screen; held: the menu.
To keep a sound: stop, tap SAVE, pick the slot with KNOB 1, then OCT+ twice. Held: undo (UNDO).
Records, on all pages; held on STEP, PATTERN or CHANCE, clears the track's sequence (OCT+ confirms).
Changes the sound, on all pages that are not lists; on SEQ pages, moves the step cursor.
Picks the track, on all pages.

gestes: A layer button tapped twice: keeps the layer open.
a_savoir: The MIDI additions come from the MiniLab 3: its setup is described separately (controllers/MiniLab-3.md), which this sheet has not read.
